fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-03-28 at roughly 11:15, it was reported that a person allegedly threatened the complainant at Kalai Park Main Street and took a laptop bag. Anand Natarajan approached Thanjavur East PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000327. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. The complainant noted the registration number TN-45-XX-1036 of a green scooter. Vignesh Balan (9000000105), described as a co-worker, was also mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects reportedly approached in a secluded stretch and left quickly. A scooter was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: robbery, threat, associate, scooter, morning, main street, photograph
